import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 200;
    static final int INF = 199999999;
    static int[][] grid = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] graph;
    static int n, N, T;
    static int[][] humans = new int[MAXN+1][3];
    static int[][] robots = new int[MAXN+1][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int cx, cy;
    static int[][] dirs = {{0,-1},{0,1},{-1,0},{1,0}};
    static int[] dist;
    static boolean[] inq;
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head;
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;
    static int[] level, cur;

    static class Edge {
        int st, ed, flow, next;
        Edge(int s, int e, int f, int nxt) {
            st = s; ed = e; flow = f; next = nxt;
        }
    }

    static int isValid(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && grid[r][c] != -1)
            return (r-1)*n + c;
        return -1;
    }

    static void buildGraph() {
        N = n * n;
        graph = new int[N+1][N+1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) Arrays.fill(graph[i], -1);
        for (int r = 1; r <= n; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; c++) {
                if (grid[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int p = (r-1)*n + c;
                graph[p][p] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nr = r + dirs[d][0];
                    int nc = c + dirs[d][1];
                    if (nr > 0 && nr <= n && nc > 0 && nc <= n && grid[nr][nc] != -1) {
                        int np = (nr-1)*n + nc;
                        graph[p][np] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa() {
        dist = new int[N+1];
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        inq = new boolean[N+1];
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        int start = (zr-1)*n + zc;
        dist[start] = 0;
        q.add(start);
        inq[start] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inq[u] = false;
            for (int v = 1; v <= N; v++) {
                if (graph[u][v] == 1 && dist[v] > dist[u] + 1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    if (!inq[v]) {
                        q.add(v);
                        inq[v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void floyd() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= N; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                if (graph[i][k] == -1) continue;
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                    if (graph[k][j] == -1) continue;
                    if (graph[i][j] == -1 || graph[i][j] > graph[i][k] + graph[k][j])
                        graph[i][j] = graph[i][k] + graph[k][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edges.add(new Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st]));
        head[st] = E++;
        edges.add(new Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed]));
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    static void buildFlow() {
        head = new int[cx+cy+2];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edges.clear();
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++)
            addEdge(src, i, humans[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= cy; i++)
            addEdge(cx + i, dest, robots[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= cy; j++) {
                int p1 = (humans[i][0]-1)*n + humans[i][1];
                int p2 = (robots[j][0]-1)*n + robots[j][1];
                if (graph[p1][p2] != -1 && graph[p1][p2] <= T && graph[p1][p2] < dist[p2]) {
                    addEdge(i, cx + j, INF);
                } else if (graph[p1][p2] != -1 && graph[p1][p2] <= T && graph[p1][p2] == dist[p2]) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int rr = robots[j][0] + dirs[d][0];
                        int cc = robots[j][1] + dirs[d][1];
                        int pp = isValid(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (graph[p1][pp] == graph[p1][p2] - 1 && graph[p1][pp] < dist[pp]) {
                                addEdge(i, cx + j, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean dinicBFS() {
        level = new int[dest+1];
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        level[src] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                int v = edges.get(i).ed;
                if (level[v] == -1 && edges.get(i).flow > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    if (v == dest) return true;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinicDFS(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == dest) return flow;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
            cur[u] = i;
            int v = edges.get(i).ed;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && edges.get(i).flow > 0) {
                int pushed = dinicDFS(v, Math.min(flow, edges.get(i).flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    edges.get(i).flow -= pushed;
                    edges.get(i^1).flow += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (dinicBFS()) {
            cur = head.clone();
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dinicDFS(src, INF)) > 0)
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int solve() {
        grid[zr][zc] = 0;
        buildGraph();
        spfa();
        grid[zr][zc] = -1;
        buildGraph();
        floyd();
        buildFlow();
        return dinic();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        cx = cy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) Arrays.fill(grid[i], 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i; zc = j+1;
                    grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                } else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    humans[++cx][0] = i;
                    humans[cx][1] = j+1;
                    humans[cx][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    robots[++cy][0] = i;
                    robots[cy][1] = j+1;
                    robots[cy][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve());
        sc.close();
    }
}
